parts.meaning: The air fryer runs hotter than the dial says, because the fan pushes hot air straight onto the food. Dropping 25F keeps the outside from burning before the centre thaws.
The fan cooks food about 20 percent faster than still oven air, so the air fryer time is four fifths of the oven time.
The check-at time is 70 percent of the oven time. Open the basket then and look for golden edges.
Frozen food goes straight from the freezer to the basket. The converted time covers thawing and cooking together.

formula.text: Air fryer temp = oven temp minus 25F. Air fryer time = oven time × 0.8. Check at = oven time × 0.7. For frozen food at 425F for 25 minutes: 400F for 20 minutes, check at 18 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Read the package
howToSteps.text: Find the oven temperature and time on the bag or box. Frozen fries usually say 425F for 25 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Convert both numbers
howToSteps.text: Take 25F off the temperature and take 20 percent off the time. 425F for 25 minutes becomes 400F for 20 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Load straight from the freezer
howToSteps.text: No thawing, no oil. Spread the food in a single layer so the hot air reaches every piece.

howToSteps.name: Shake and check early
howToSteps.text: Shake halfway through. Start checking at 18 minutes, and pull the food when it is golden and hot through.

lede: Frozen food that bakes at 425F for 25 minutes air fries at 400F for 20 minutes, straight from the freezer. Start checking at 18 minutes, and shake the basket halfway.

title: Oven to Air Fryer: Frozen Foods
tutorial: Frozen food is the best job for an air fryer, because it goes straight from the freezer to the basket with no thawing and no prep. A bag of fries that bakes at 425F for 25 minutes air fries at 400F for 20 minutes. Start checking at 18 minutes.

The package directions are your starting point, and this converter translates them. Read the oven temperature and time off the bag or the box, convert both numbers, and cook. The package knows the food better than any chart does, and the converted settings keep what the package knows while fitting the faster machine.

One thing is different for frozen food. Some guides keep the oven temperature and only cut the time, because frozen food needs the heat to thaw and cook at once. This converter applies the standard rule to both numbers, and the check-at time is the safety net. If the first batch comes out pale, keep the oven temperature next time and use the converted time.

No oil, no thawing, no preheating debate. Frozen food already holds the oil it needs, so it crisps with nothing added. A preheat helps for a short cook, and matters less for a long one, because the food warms up with the basket either way.

One exception matters more than any time on this page. Raw, stuffed, breaded chicken breast products should not be cooked in an air fryer at all. The breading browns before the filling is safe, and the package instructions are written for an oven for a reason. Follow the package for those, every time.
